subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Easter Island is a remote island located about 2,300 miles off the coast of Chile.
• Archaeologists have long believed that in the thirteenth century Polynesian seafarers were the first humans to settle Easter Island.
• A 2019 study coauthored by Bao Vu and Dr. Rahim Hossain found that inhabitants from South America may have settled Easter Island as early as the tenth century.
• The researchers discovered similarities between ancient pottery fragments on Easter Island and those found in Peru.
• These pottery styles may have traveled from Peru to Easter Island with South American voyagers.
prompt: The student wants to specify who may have first settled Easter Island, according to the 2019 study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: According to a 2019 study, the first humans to settle Easter Island may have been inhabitants from South America, not seafarers from Polynesia as previously believed.
choices.B: Archaeologists have long believed that the first humans to settle Easter Island, a remote island about 2,300 miles off the coast of Chile, arrived in the thirteenth century.
choices.C: Polynesian seafarers may not have been the first humans to settle Easter Island.
choices.D: In their 2019 study, the researchers discovered similarities between ancient pottery fragments on Easter Island and those found in Peru.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer. This choice effectively specifies who may have first settled Easter Island, according to the 2019 study: inhabitants from South America.
